capabilities: Paste clipboard content as HTML via a command palette command
Preserve the original CSS style of copied web text
extras: README is a minimal bullet list with no usage examples, screenshots, or details beyond the basic copy-then-paste workflow.
problem: Pasting text from a browser into Obsidian normally strips the original styling, so users who want to keep the source HTML and its CSS have no built-in way to do so.
summary: Paste command that inserts web content copied from a browser as HTML, keeping the original CSS styles instead of converting to Markdown.
